question: In which state did Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurate India’s first modern, selfsufficient gaushala named Adarsh Gaushala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated India's first modern, self-sufficient gaushala named Adarsh Gaushala in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The Adarsh Gaushala is designed to be a model for cattle care and management, incorporating modern technology and sustainable practices.
 
• This initiative aims to improve the welfare of cattle by providing better facilities and ensuring their well-being.
 
• The gaushala is equipped with facilities for the production of biogas and organic fertilizers, promoting environmental sustainability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gaushala:**

 
 
• A gaushala is a protective shelter for cows in India. It is an integral part of the rural economy and agricultural practices.
 
• Gaushalas aim to provide shelter to old, unproductive, and abandoned cows, ensuring their safety and well-being.
 
• They often serve as centers for the production of dairy products, organic manure, and biogas.
 
 
 
• **Biogas Production:**
 
 
• Biogas is produced by the anaerobic digestion of organic matter such as cow dung, agricultural waste, and food waste.
 
• It is a renewable source of energy that can be used for cooking, heating, and generating electricity.
 
• Biogas production helps in waste management and reduces greenhouse gas emissions.
 
 
 
• **Organic Fertilizers:**
 
 
• Organic fertilizers are derived from natural sources such as animal manure, compost, and plant residues.
 
• They improve soil fertility and structure, promoting healthy plant growth.
 
• Using organic fertilizers reduces the dependence on chemical fertilizers, contributing to sustainable agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Cattle Welfare:**
 
 
• Cattle welfare involves ensuring proper nutrition, healthcare, and living conditions for cattle.
 
• It includes regular veterinary care, adequate shelter, and access to clean water and nutritious feed.
 
• Improving cattle welfare enhances their productivity and contributes to the overall agricultural economy.
